blocks.orig: Sharazad Wonders Boutique Hotel in Stone Town has just 8 rooms, split between four suites, two suites with private balconies, and two veranda Suites (a good fit for families, with one king bed and two twin beds). Every room comes with an en-suite bathroom with a hot and cold shower, as well as a ceiling fan, air conditioning, and coffee and tea facilities. Each room also has its own decor scheme, so no two look quite alike. For meals, the restaurant and café serve a fusion of traditional and modern Zanzibari dishes, built around fresh, market-sourced ingredients.
